| 0406211       | Contemporary Issues in Ritual actions            | 3            |
| **Prerequisites:** | 0406112, 040611                          |

**Course description:**  
This subject examines a set of contemporary issues in the domain of worship. It covers topics such as the rulings on impossibilities, the use of purified sewage water for purification purposes, dry cleaning of clothes, the impact of dyes and fats on purification, the use of alcohol-based perfumes, prayer on an airplane, the effect of kidney dialysis on purification, the use of impurities in treatment, rulings on prayer and fasting in regions with prolonged day or night, proving Ramadan using modern means, and the rulings on Stoning (Ramy) before midday, stoning from upper floors in Mina, the obligation of immediate Hajj for those who have violated it and cannot obtain permission. The subject also addresses the instructor's observations regarding relevant developments.

| 0406151       | Jurisprudential Schools                           | 3            |
| **Prerequisites:** | -                                          |

**Course description:**  
This course covers general concepts related to jurisprudence and its principles, as well as Sharia. It defines jurisprudence, its terminology, characteristics, and its relationship with Sharia. It explains the concept and characteristics of Sharia, tracing the stages of the development of Islamic jurisprudence, legislative roles it underwent, and contributions made by prominent jurists. Students will be introduced to jurisprudential schools, their founders, terminologies, and authoritative books. The course examines factors influencing the development of jurisprudential movements, the role of independent legal reasoning (ijtihad), and provides practical applications from selected jurisprudential sources in different schools, along with an overview of contemporary jurists' contributions.

| **Prerequisites:** | -                                          |

**Course description:**  
This course covers the definition of jurisprudential principles, distinguishing them from legal guidelines, fundamental principles, similarities, and analogies. It addresses theoretical jurisprudential issues, Maqasid (objectives) theories, and jurisprudential concepts.
